raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

SageMaker only sends inference requests to `POST /invocations`, and ours only handles chat completions. So you can't serve an embedding model, or use the completions API, on SageMaker today. (#3740 mentioned this might be worth doing.)

## Modifications

`/invocations` now looks at the request body and forwards it to the existing route:

- `messages` → `/v1/chat/completions`
- `prompt` → `/v1/completions`
- `input` → `/v1/embeddings`

`messages` is checked first, so anything that worked before still goes to chat the same way.

I went with matching on keys instead of trying each request model until one validates (what vLLM does). Here `ScoringRequest` accepts any body and `input` fits three different models, so the result would depend on the order of the list.

A few other changes:
- A body that isn't a JSON object (e.g. an array or `text/plain`) now returns 400 instead of 500.
- A body without any of the three keys returns 400 listing the keys we accept.
- The SageMaker docs page lists the keys.

Things that change as a side effect: the OpenAPI schema for `/invocations` is now a plain object, and the HTTP metrics count all three request types under `/invocations`.

Rerank, score and classify aren't covered here. I can do them in a follow-up.

## Accuracy Tests

Ran on one L4. Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct for chat/completions (`temperature=0`), gte-Qwen2-1.5B-instruct with `--is-embedding` for embeddings. `/invocations` gives the same output as the native routes:

```
PASS  chat: /invocations == /v1/chat/completions
PASS  completions: /invocations == /v1/completions
PASS  completions stream: same SSE text
PASS  chat stream: same SSE text
PASS  embedding body on a generation server: 400 (asks for --is-embedding)
PASS  unknown body: 400
PASS  embeddings: matches /v1/embeddings (min cosine 0.999999)
```

Embeddings are compared by cosine: two `/v1/embeddings` calls in a row already differ by about 4e-4 in bf16.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A, it's one dict lookup before the same validation the native routes do.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+"""SageMaker /invocations: dispatch by body key to the chat, completions and
+embeddings routes, checked against fake serving handlers without a server."""
+
+import unittest
+
+from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints import http_server
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_HANDLERS = (
+    "openai_serving_chat",
+    "openai_serving_completion",
+    "openai_serving_embedding",
+)
+_CHAT_BODY = {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]}
+
+
+class _RecordingHandler:
+    def __init__(self, name, response=None):
+        self.name = name
+        self.response = response
+        self.requests = []
+
+    async def handle_request(self, request, raw_request):
+        self.requests.append(request)
+        if self.response is not None:
+            return self.response
+        return {"handler": self.name, "request": type(request).__name__}
+
+
+class TestSageMakerInvocations(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        state = http_server.app.state
+        self._saved = {name: getattr(state, name, None) for name in _HANDLERS}
+        self.handlers = {name: _RecordingHandler(name) for name in _HANDLERS}
+        for name, handler in self.handlers.items():
+            setattr(state, name, handler)
+        self.client = TestClient(http_server.app)
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        for name, handler in self._saved.items():
+            setattr(http_server.app.state, name, handler)
+
+    def post(self, **kwargs):
+        return self.client.post("/invocations", **kwargs)
+
+    def test_messages_takes_precedence(self):
+        """A chat body that also carries `prompt` or `input` must keep reaching chat."""
+        response = self.post(json={**_CHAT_BODY, "prompt": "p", "input": "i"})
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            response.json(),
+            {"handler": "openai_serving_chat", "request": "ChatCompletionRequest"},
+        )
+
+    def test_routes_by_key(self):
+        for body, handler, request in (
+            ({"prompt": "hi"}, "openai_serving_completion", "CompletionRequest"),
+            ({"input": "hi"}, "openai_serving_embedding", "EmbeddingRequest"),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(body=body):
+                response = self.post(json=body)
+                self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    response.json(), {"handler": handler, "request": request}
+                )
+
+    def test_unknown_body_is_rejected_without_echo(self):
+        for body in ({"query": "secret-query", "documents": ["d"]}, {}):
+            with self.subTest(body=body):
+                response = self.post(json=body)
+                self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
+                self.assertNotIn("secret-query", response.text)
+                self.assertTrue(all(not h.requests for h in self.handlers.values()))
+
+    def test_non_object_body_is_400(self):
+        """Bodies that are not a JSON object used to reach the chat model and return 500."""
+        for kwargs in (
+            {"content": b'{"messages": []}', "headers": {"content-type": "text/plain"}},
+            {"json": [1]},
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(kwargs=kwargs):
+                self.assertEqual(self.post(**kwargs).status_code, 400)
+        response = self.post(
+            json=_CHAT_BODY, headers={"content-type": "application/vnd.api+json"}
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
+
+    def test_invalid_field_is_400_on_that_field(self):
+        response = self.post(json={"prompt": 1.5})
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
+        self.assertIn("'body', 'prompt'", response.json()["message"])
+
+    def test_streaming_passes_through(self):
+        """A stream from the chosen route must reach the client as-is, not be re-serialized."""
+
+        async def chunks():
+            yield b"data: one\n\n"
+            yield b"data: [DONE]\n\n"
+
+        self.handlers["openai_serving_completion"].response = StreamingResponse(
+            chunks(), media_type="text/event-stream"
+        )
+        response = self.post(json={"prompt": "hi", "stream": True})
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
+        self.assertTrue(
+            response.headers["content-type"].startswith("text/event-stream")
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(response.content, b"data: one\n\ndata: [DONE]\n\n")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
